items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Which one is that? The trumpet player? Red Allen. From over the river.

ctx.x: And I worked with, uh, with Buddy Allen.
Which one is that? The trumpet player? Red Allen. From over the river.
Yeah. Did he have a good band? Yeah, he had a good band. Well he used to bring boys too from, he used to hire fellas from here, you know, over here. He used to hire fellas from over here.
